rec-build-info-toggle.description: Hides or shows the build text in the corner. Leave a key for it. Valve wants it in bug clips.
rec-build-info-toggle.label: Toggle build info text

rec-buy-force.description: Light armor, a cheap rifle, flash and smoke.
rec-buy-force.label: Force buy

rec-buy-full.description: Rifle, armor, nades and a defuser. The wrong rifle for the side is ignored. buy m4a1 buys the M4A4.
rec-buy-full.label: Full buy

rec-drop.description: Drops the weapon you are holding. Select the bomb first to drop it.
rec-drop.label: Drop item

rec-fps-toggle.description: Shows or hides the FPS counter.
rec-fps-toggle.label: Toggle FPS counter

rec-hand-toggle.description: Swaps hands. The saved side is cl_prefer_lefthanded, under Settings.
rec-hand-toggle.label: Swap weapon hand

rec-lineup-release.description: Releases the smoke at the top of a jump. Hold space, then press this key. One action, so it works on Valve servers.
rec-lineup-release.label: Lineup release

rec-molotov.description: Molotov on T, incendiary on CT. Slot 10.
rec-molotov.label: Molotov / Incendiary

rec-mwheel-jump.description: Jump on mouse wheel. One action, so it works on Valve servers.
rec-mwheel-jump.label: Mouse-wheel jump

rec-radar-hud.description: Steps the radar size on the HUD.
rec-radar-hud.label: Radar HUD size

config.addAllDescription: Replaces the settings with the recommended set.
config.addAllRecommendedDescription: Replaces every setting with the recommended set.
config.alwaysCenteredDescription: cl_radar_always_centered — off shows more of the map.
config.alwaysLoadoutDescription: cl_showloadout — always show the weapon loadout panel.
config.bufferTicksDescription: cl_net_buffer_ticks. Extra snapshot delay. 0 is the lowest.
config.buildInfoDescription: r_show_build_info — version/debug overlay in the corner.

rec-audio-clean.description: Turns off round, menu and MVP music. Keeps the bomb beep. Lowers teammate voice. Voice is snd_voipvolume.
rec-audio-clean.label: Mute music, lower voice

rec-hud-classic-sniper-scope.description: Hides the moving spread circle on the AWP and SSG 08. Same as Settings → Game → Sniper Sights → Show Scoped Sniper Rifle Inaccuracy → No.
rec-hud-classic-sniper-scope.label: Classic AWP/Scout scope

rec-hud-hide-build-info.description: Hides the version text in the corner. Leave a key to turn it back on. Valve wants it in bug clips.
rec-hud-hide-build-info.label: Hide build info text

rec-hud-readable.description: Green HUD, slightly smaller, teammate colors with letters.
rec-hud-readable.label: Readable competitive HUD

rec-hud-teamid-fade.description: Names fade when the crosshair is on a teammate. 0 turns the fade off.
rec-hud-teamid-fade.label: Fade teammate names at crosshair

rec-mouse-raw.description: Scoped sensitivity matches hip-fire. Raw input is always on.
rec-mouse-raw.label: 1.0 zoom sensitivity ratio

rec-network-competitive.description: Unrestricted rate, no extra buffer. Interp is not a setting you can change.
rec-network-competitive.label: Competitive network

rec-perf-fps.description: Uncapped in-game FPS with 120 fps menu cap.
rec-perf-fps.label: Uncapped FPS + UI cap

rec-perf-low-latency.description: Moves the Reflex/low-latency sleep after client sim. Pair with a real `fps_max`, not 0.
rec-perf-low-latency.label: Engine low-latency sleep

rec-perf-no-clutter.description: Turns off auto-help and the game instructor.
rec-perf-no-clutter.label: Disable help popups

rec-radar-lineups.description: Zoomed-out radar, larger on the HUD.
rec-radar-lineups.label: Competitive radar (lineups)

rec-vm-wide.description: FOV 68, offsets 2.5 / 2 / -2. presetpos has to be 0 or the offsets are ignored.
rec-vm-wide.label: Wide competitive viewmodel

config.lowLatencyDescription: engine_low_latency_sleep_after_client_tick — pair with a real fps_max, not 0.
config.muteAltTabDescription: snd_mute_losefocus — mute the game when alt-tabbed.

wide-competitive.description: FOV 68, offsets 2.5 / 2 / -2. presetpos 0 so the offsets stick.
wide-competitive.label: Wide competitive

config.rateDescription: rate — max bytes/sec from the server. 786432 is Unrestricted in the menu.
config.recommendedSubtitle: Add one, or take the set.
config.resetDescription: Restores every section to Valve defaults.
config.rotateRadarDescription: cl_radar_rotate — rotate the radar with your view.
config.sniperInaccuracyDescription: cl_sniper_show_inaccuracy — moving spread circle on AWP/SSG 08. Off restores the classic overlay.

0.description: Cross that spreads with real weapon inaccuracy.
0.label: Dynamic Cross

1.description: Ring that grows with real weapon inaccuracy.
1.label: Dynamic Circle

2.description: CS:GO-era dynamic cross with split arms and negative gaps.
2.label: Dynamic Cross (Classic)

5.description: Static cross that only reacts when firing.
5.label: Dynamic Cross (Legacy/Shot Feedback)

6.description: Just the center dot. Sized by thickness.
6.label: Dot Only

7.description: Four arcs that spread with inaccuracy. Game default.
7.label: Dynamic Quadrant

9.description: Fixed ring split into four arcs. Arc size is adjustable.
9.label: Static Quadrant
